title: Taking a slice after an encoded drop
statement: For natural numbers $a,k,i$ and bit strings $x,u$, let $L=a(|x|+1)^k$. Applying the slice-take operation to the encoding of $x$ paired with $u$ after its first $iL$ bits have been removed gives the encoding of $x$ paired with the first $L$ bits of that remaining suffix (or the entire suffix if it has fewer than $L$ bits).
